traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are implemented and verified. The plugin fully supports the `@supports ...` format, validates each requirement ID against its specific story file with clear error context including story path, maintains backward-compatible behavior for existing `@story` and `@req` annotations, and allows mixed usage of both styles in the same file/comment. Deep validation correctly scopes requirement IDs per story file using multi-story fixtures. Both `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` rules treat `@supports` as satisfying their respective requirements, as confirmed by dedicated tests. Documentation and ADR 011 are aligned with the final `@supports` design. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED based on concrete code and passing tests.
